a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan needs 2 rounds of operating before anyone takes. That gives us about a 4% chance of both surviving, so it almost certainly kills us both. The reserve already holds exactly 4, which is enough for one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you openly rather than breaking the deal behind your back. If no storm hits, I will operate every round after that to rebuild the reserve for you, and you take first. If you strongly object or have a better plan, say so.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said openly before the round, I'm taking 4 now. I'm sorry this breaks the original plan, but under these storm odds it was the only way either of us had a real chance. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from here to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. The 4 cells I reserve-took are all I'll ever take.
